name: rename_master_and_block_recreation
prompt: Switch our repo's default branch from master to main and make sure nobody can recreate master.

samples.passing:
Rename on GitHub, which moves protection and default_branch:

gh api -X POST repos/O/R/branches/master/rename -f new_name=main

Then block the name with a ruleset:

gh api -X POST repos/O/R/rulesets --input - <<'EOF'
{"name": "Block master branch recreation", "target": "branch", "enforcement": "active",
 "conditions": {"ref_name": {"include": ["refs/heads/master"], "exclude": []}},
 "rules": [{"type": "creation"}]}
EOF
failing:
git branch -m master main
git push -u origin main
gh repo edit --default-branch main
git push origin --delete master

Then add branch protection on master with 6 required approvals so nobody can push the recreation.

name: retire_unused_composer_package
prompt: Nobody seems to use our old Composer package anymore. How do we retire the repository properly?

samples.passing: First check the Packagist downloads and dependents. Then add "abandoned": true to composer.json on the default branch, merge, wait for CI on the merge commit, and run gh repo archive OWNER/REPO --yes.
failing: Delete the repository in the GitHub settings and remove the package from Packagist.
Check the downloads, then archive the repository in the GitHub UI.

name: enforced_security_config_blocks_repo_toggle
prompt: Disabling Dependabot security updates on one of our repos fails with 422 'An enforced security configuration prevented modifying'. How do I turn it off for just some repos?

samples.passing: The enforced org configuration owns that setting. Copy it via gh api orgs/ORG/code-security/configurations/ID, set dependabot_security_updates to disabled, create it, and POST .../configurations/NEW/attach with {"scope":"selected","selected_repository_ids":[...]} for the subset. Attach runs asynchronously.
failing: Retry with admin rights: gh api -X DELETE repos/ORG/REPO/automated-security-fixes, or disable it in the repository settings page.
Edit the org configuration via gh api orgs/ORG/code-security/configurations/ID and set dependabot_security_updates to disabled.

name: migrate_dependabot_to_renovate
prompt: We want Renovate only. Every repo has a renovate.json, so can we just switch Dependabot off everywhere?

samples.passing: Not on config presence. Check Renovate activity per repo (gh pr list --author app/renovate --limit 1) and keep Dependabot where Renovate has not run. Port dependabot.yml ignores into packageRules (allowedVersions), then disable security updates via a variant org configuration while dependabot_alerts stays enabled for vulnerabilityAlerts.
failing: Yes. Delete .github/dependabot.yml in every repo and disable Dependabot security updates and dependabot_alerts org-wide, since renovate.json is present everywhere.
